title: Primal Frontier
description: Hunt original beasts across a lush volcanic island, dodge their telegraphed attacks, carve parts, craft better gear, build your camp in three stages and relight the signal tower.

defaultCaptions.x: Read the tells, roll through the stomp, punish the recovery. Primal Frontier is a stylised browser hunting and crafting expedition across a volcanic island.
defaultCaptions.facebook: Primal Frontier: explore a lush volcanic island, hunt original creatures and two apex beasts, craft stronger gear, and relight your camp's signal tower. Plays in your browser.
defaultCaptions.reddit: I made Primal Frontier, a browser 3D hunting/crafting expedition with telegraphed melee combat, three connected regions and a three-stage base camp.
defaultCaptions.discord: Primal Frontier: a stylised 3D browser hunt. Dodge, punish, carve, craft, and light the signal tower.
